nodes.name: Hook frame and shared state
nodes.what: The shared frame every hook runs in: stdin parsing, crash log, paths, per-session state and the settings switches.

nodes.name: Hook texts and transcript reader
nodes.what: The strings hooks write and scanners match, plus the reader of Claude Code's transcript file and the Russian-language checks.

nodes.name: Automatic code review gate
nodes.what: Asks for a reviewer agent (split by part on a big job, with a blind-reviewer when a person will see the result) after enough code files change in a session.

nodes.name: Build and test gate
nodes.what: Stops a reply when code was edited and nothing was built or tested after it.

nodes.name: Reply-format gates
nodes.what: Stop hooks that check the reply before it goes out: links opened, file links clickable, no idle next step, every question answered, no commands left to the user, web claims checked. no-response-gate also runs on PreToolUse: in the turn after the user stopped the session it refuses work calls (helpers, edits, new sessions) until the user says go or start.

nodes.name: Helper brief gates
nodes.what: PreToolUse and PostToolUse checks on subagent calls: budget, quoted decisions, a plan row's Serves cell pasted into the brief, context size, a helper that stopped cut or empty, and the read-only shell of the planner, plan-reviewer and reviewer.

nodes.name: Shell command guards
nodes.what: Hooks that read a Bash or PowerShell command or a big file read before it runs: explanation line, destructive SQL, bulk deletes, long sleeps, drive-wide searches, big downloads sent to the range downloader, slow pipes, read-only browser CLI, whole-file dumps, keys in a git push.

nodes.name: Nimbalyst tool gates
nodes.what: Hooks for Nimbalyst's own tools: a typing box on every question (the card first), the form-answer note, pictures kept in the project, visible browser, session notes.

nodes.name: Context cost and loop hooks
nodes.what: Hooks that keep a long session cheap: compact focus, cold cache warning, background wake-ups, repeated calls, finished-job nudge. background-tasks also refuses a main-session foreground wait over 2 min (a CI watch, a poll loop, a sleep); a background wait that polls or watches passes.

nodes.name: Housekeeping nudges
nodes.what: One-line prompts at a message or session start: the chat archive every 3 days, the patch list, new Claude Code experiments and feature flags, and facts past their recheck date.

nodes.name: Session cleanup
nodes.what: A session closes what it started (dev servers, watchers, headless browsers, background shells) when it ends and names the worktrees other or earlier sessions left in the project, never removing one; report mode until SESSION_CLEANUP=on.

nodes.name: Systems map hooks
nodes.what: The hooks that give helpers the map lines, flag drifted links, refuse edits of generated files and ask for a map.

nodes.name: Systems map skill
nodes.what: The map.mjs reader and the SKILL.md that tells a worker how to build, check and settle a project's map.

nodes.name: Systems map graph panel
nodes.what: The Nimbalyst panel that draws the project's map as a graph with cards for each part.

nodes.name: Helper run log and Agents Panel
nodes.what: One line per helper into agent-runs.jsonl, read by the Agents Panel.

nodes.name: Plan usage log and dashboard
nodes.what: Plan-percentage samples, the usage-plan panel, the usage dashboard and its trigger word.

nodes.name: Setup audit scanners
nodes.what: The setup-audit skill: scripts that read chats and usage and write the audit, with their own small libraries.

nodes.name: Session handoff
nodes.what: Writes a short brief of a session so work continues in a fresh one; the session comes from CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID (or --session), and the brief is built from that session's own transcript and summary.

nodes.name: Steer and self-compact
nodes.what: Mid-turn steering of a session and the compact of itself, driven by hooks. The note asks for the mid-turn notes to be listed back under "### Your notes" and says when a note waited 2 min or more.

nodes.name: Phone bot
nodes.what: A chat-app bot that takes requests and voice notes and starts sessions through Nimbalyst.

nodes.name: Setup update and release
nodes.what: Version check on prompt (and the self-install of a files-only release), the update-setup skill that installs a newer release, the tidy of the person's own rules, and the version and changelog files.

nodes.name: Project update pass
nodes.what: /update-project brings one project folder up to the current setup, every change shown first, and stamps the folder as done at the pass level.

nodes.name: Installer core
nodes.what: install.mjs and its steps: the file helpers, the repo sources and the setup state it remembers.

nodes.name: Hook wiring
nodes.what: Puts the hooks of settings.example.json into the user's settings and takes retired ones out.

nodes.name: Claude home files and rules
nodes.what: Copies hooks, agents, skills and workers into the Claude home folder, merges the rules into CLAUDE.md and sets the model.

nodes.name: Project templates
nodes.what: Starter projects the installer places in the user's folders (claude-settings, quick-tasks), and the retired folders an update merges into quick-tasks.

nodes.name: Nimbalyst install steps
nodes.what: Finds Nimbalyst, builds and installs the extensions, sets the theme, plugins and app settings.

nodes.name: Nimbalyst patcher
nodes.what: Puts fixes into Nimbalyst's app.asar and takes them out again: status, apply, skip on a changed anchor, retire, restore. Tests point it at other program folders with NIMBALYST_PATCH_PROGRAM_DIRS. patches/updater-block.mjs turns Nimbalyst's own updater off: requiredFirst (applied before all others; without it no patch is applied), upstream: null (never retires), and a quit listener that reads staged.json from the delivery's data folder, logs to quit-hook.log and answers the quit word --ai-coding-setup-quit. patches/1944.mjs requires 1558; its upstream marker is `function answersPushedMessage(`. patches/ask-line.mjs rewrites the question block of Nimbalyst's built-in system prompt (a card only for a quick yes/no or pick-one; never retires). pin.json pins the Nimbalyst version the setup delivers and its patch list; deliver.mjs (Windows) downloads, checks, installs and patches the pinned version, with --off/--on and NIMBALYST_FOLLOW=off; restart.mjs closes Nimbalyst, installs, patches and reopens it.

nodes.name: Worker, reviewer and planner agents
nodes.what: The agent definitions the main session hands work to, the stuck-advisor a stuck session asks, and the version checker worker.

nodes.name: Quick tasks project
nodes.what: The side-work folder for questions, finding things online and one-off file jobs: the finder skill and its link gate, and tools/peek.mjs, which reads pages in Nimbalyst's browser or Obscura and with --save keeps each page's whole text in a file.

nodes.name: Web research skills
nodes.what: Skills for web research (the page-reading ladder, cheapest step first) and signed-in sites.

nodes.name: PC tidy
nodes.what: Shows and frees memory held by finished sessions.

nodes.name: Disk tidy
nodes.what: Report-first disk cleanup: leftover worktrees, old chat logs, scratch and temp folders, old project copies; the 60-day chat archive and its restore.

nodes.name: File upkeep
nodes.what: The file standard (names, places, decisions archive) and the checker that lists misnamed and misplaced files, with the reorganize ledger and undo.

nodes.name: Session board cleanup
nodes.what: Archives finished sessions on the Nimbalyst board.

nodes.name: Workflow skills
nodes.what: Planning and design skills: lead, next-move, btw, new-project, design-system, untangle.

nodes.name: Extension shared build
nodes.what: Build helpers, design tokens and the host bridge the Nimbalyst extensions share.

nodes.name: Commands extension
nodes.what: Slash command finder and composer inside Nimbalyst.

nodes.name: Read-aloud extension
nodes.what: Reads replies aloud with a local voice model.

nodes.name: Ink themes
nodes.what: Eleven colour themes added to Nimbalyst's theme list.

nodes.name: Test suite and privacy check
nodes.what: run-all with an empty home, the kit and the check that nothing private ships.

nodes.name: Homepage film
nodes.what: The Remotion film and stills for the repo page.

nodes.name: Blind reviewer agent
nodes.what: A reviewer that sees only what a person will see (screenshots, text, command output, docs), never the code or the chat, and ranks its flaws; it holds the screen checks of the retired blind-screen-review skill.

nodes.name: Video watching (/watch)
nodes.what: /watch turns a link or a video file into timed words and sheets of timed stills; with no subtitles, or when YouTube refuses them, it turns the sound into text on the computer (ffmpeg's whisper filter, else faster-whisper), long audio in pieces side by side.

nodes.name: Obscura headless browser
nodes.what: The install puts one pinned Obscura release (SHA-256 checked) in ~/.claude/obscura (--obscura no leaves it out); peek.mjs reads with it when Nimbalyst's browser can't be reached or with --engine obscura; --uninstall removes the folder.

nodes.name: Install opt-ins (voice typing, backup)
nodes.what: The first install's chat asks once about voice typing with Handy and the encrypted backup; install.mjs --handy and --backup only keep the answers in setup-state.json, and an update never asks voice typing again and asks the backup only while no answer is on record.

nodes.name: Backup (/backup)
nodes.what: Encrypted restic backup (pinned 0.19.1) of the Claude folder and picked project folders to the person's own Backblaze B2 storage, set up with a key that can't delete; runs when asked or daily or weekly, with a restore test before the schedule starts and monthly, and restores into a new folder.

Check P9 lists the dated facts with recheck-dates --list.

An update never asks voice typing (a Handy found on the computer goes on record as yes) and says one Backup line, asking the backup once while no answer is on record.
